meta.title: Data Q&A (NL2SQL)
meta.description: Open Data Q&A in the sidebar to connect MySQL 5.7+, PostgreSQL or Elasticsearch (optionally over SSH), or upload CSV / Excel. After schema analysis, ask in plain language: the agent writes read-only SQL, runs it and charts the result in the conversation. Includes dashboards with global filters, drill-down and change attribution, a metric library and business knowledge, accuracy evaluation, alerts and scheduled reports, Lark / Feishu push and an @-mention bot, member scopes (data sources, viewer role, row-level rules) and audit. A setting controls what result data reaches the model (column statistics by default). Passwords live in the Harness credential store; data and logs stay in ~/.dsh/nl2sql. Turning the plugin off stops its page, tools and scheduled checks; saved data is kept.
